method.name: milp_workforce_production
steps: Define weekly decisions: skilled_producing[t], skilled_training[t], new_trainees[t], overtime_hours[t], prod_I[t], prod_II[t], backlog_I[t], backlog_II[t]
Worker state: initial 50 skilled workers; each trainee takes 2 weeks to become trained
Production capacity: (skilled_producing[t] * 40 + overtime_hours[t]) * rate <= prod_I[t], prod_II[t]
Training constraint: each skilled worker in training can handle up to 3 trainees per 2-week batch; trainer not producing during training
Training workers not producing: total training slots = sum over weeks of min(3*skilled_training[week], new_trainees[week])
Worker balance per week: skilled_producing[t] + skilled_training[t] <= available_skilled[t]
Trained worker availability: trained[t] = sum of trainees who finished training by week t
Backlog dynamics: backlog_I[t] = backlog_I[t-1] + demand_I[t] - prod_I[t]; similarly for II
Objective: minimize sum of (skilled_wage*skilled + trainee_wage*new_trainees + trained_wage*trained + overtime_premium*overtime + penalty_I*backlog_I + penalty_II*backlog_II)
Total trainees started by week 8 >= 50
All production and backlog variables >= 0; trainee counts integer

method.name: milp_aggregate_planning
steps: Aggregate planning approach: track workforce levels (skilled, in-training, trained) as state variables per week
Production variables: prod_I[t], prod_II[t] for each week t
Inventory/backlog variables: inv_I[t], inv_II[t] (can be negative = backlog)
Workforce transitions: trained[t] = trained[t-1] + newly_trained[t]; newly_trained[t] = trainees from 2 weeks ago
Training decisions: how many skilled workers assigned to training each week (each trainer can handle 3 trainees)
Capacity constraint: total_production_hours = (skilled_not_training + trained) * 40 + overtime_hours; each hour produces either I or II at respective rates
Product-mix: within capacity, decide split between I (10 kg/h) and II (6 kg/h)
Backlog penalty: penalty costs for unmet demand carried forward
Objective: total cost = wages + overtime premium + backlog penalties
Constraint: total new trainees by week 8 >= 50; integer constraints on trainee counts

method.name: milp_time_indexed
steps: Full time-indexed formulation: track each worker cohort's training status week by week
Binary/integer variable for number of trainees starting at each week
Production each week: continuous variable for each product type
Backlog tracking: cumulative unmet demand per product per week
Training capacity: trainees starting at week t <= 3 * skilled_not_in_production[t]
Workforce conservation: available workers = initial_skilled + trained - in_training
Capacity per week: total worker-hours >= required hours for production
Product-specific capacity: prod_I[t] / 10 + prod_II[t] / 6 <= total_worker_hours / 40
Total training requirement: sum of all trainees >= 50
Integer trainee variables for tractability; overtime allowed at premium rate
Minimize: wage costs + overtime premium + backlog penalties
